set.approach: Warmup Wall is reached by boat. At the far east corner of Clearwater Bay a channel leads into David Lake. The trail begins along the channel's northern shore, nearly at the lake end, and the wall is visible from the water. The path runs up along the foot of the wall, a short walk from the landing. The route is the bolted line in the middle of the wall, slightly off vertical with small edges.

review.notes: Area page: boat approach and trail along the base; route page: bolted line in the middle of the wall. Project, never redpointed; no descent stated.
